newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks jump in early morning trade.

text.p: Tokyo stocks jumped in early Friday morning trade, with the Nikkei average clawing back up past the 18,000 line after falling sharply on profit-taking on the previous day.
The Nikkei 225 climbed 182.18 points or 1.02 percent to 18,046.22 by 0020 GMT. Its March futures added 190 points to 18,050.

Brokers said that blue-chip buying had returned after a sell-off on Thursday. However they said that investors were still reluctant about buying domestic issues, particularly those in the banking sector.
